notes.title: Get six free games from Twitch Prime this month
notes.content:
Another month is here, and that means it's time for another round of free PC games courtesy of Twitch Prime - and yes, this is also your reminder that Amazon Prime members get the benefits of Twitch's bonus giveaways, too. This is your last chance to get April's free games - you can grab them here - before the newly-revealed May 2020 lineup hits the service.

May's free games include the non-traditional platformer Snake Pass, Swedish DJ tribute Avicii Invector, mental health exploration Fractured Minds, story-driven action platformer Pankapu, dirtbike stuntfest Urban Trial Playground, and a hand-drawn point-and-click adventure called The Little Acre.

As always, everything downloads through the standalone Twitch client. The installs are usually DRM free, so you should be able to play the games if you don't want to make use of yet another taskbar icon. You can link up an existing Amazon Prime membership to your Twitch account and enjoy the benefits of the promotion, and new subscribers can also use a free trial to grab those games.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Snake Pass: Arcade Mode is now LIVE! (Update 1.4)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We’re back with another update and some really cool new stuff to talk about. 
Would you believe that today marks a whole year since we launched Snake Pass into the world? 

It’s been a wild ride, and to celebrate the game’s first birthday, we’ve got a surprise for you.

Well… we say surprise, but by the time some of you read this, it will have already hit your consoles, so you’ll just have to just act surprised, instead…
Is that a drum roll in the distance? What bucket of thrills does that distant fanfare herald? 

Could it be…? 
Is it…? 

I think I can see something, bowling towards you right now, tumbling through its own dust clouds, eager to land on your console or PC…  A lesser-spotted CONTENT UPDATE! 

Welcome to ARCADE MODE.

You may recall that late last year we started teasing something a little bit fruity heading to Snake Pass. 

Well, it gives us great pleasure to introduce you to the brand-new mode included with update 1.4: ARCADE MODE.
 

It’s no secret that Snake Pass has a ton of retro platforming influences; after all it’s practically embedded in both Noodle and Doodle’s DNA! 
What better way to bridge the generational divide once more than by introducing an all-new retro classic with a modern, slithery twist.

ARCADE MODE is a take on the classic Score Attack mode: snake around each of Snake Pass' 15 levels, eating as much fruit as you can find to earn as high a score as possible. 

It’s simple, but ridiculously addictive. 

The aim of the game is to rack up massive multipliers and race to the gate before the time runs out as you compete with friends with full online leaderboard support. 

Jump in and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Snake Pass' latest update adds a free new Arcade Mode
notes.content:
Sumo Digital just updated its serpentine physics platformer Snake Pass, adding a free new Arcade Mode, and remedying the game's controversial home screen icon on Switch.

Arcade Mode is out now on PC, Xbox One, PS4, and Switch, and can be played on all 15 of Snake Pass' existing levels once they're unlocked in the main story campaign. It's the second bonus mode to be included in Snake Pass, following on from Time Trial Mode, and tasks players with racing around a stage and gathering up fruit.

The more fruit you eat before the timer runs out, the higher your score multiplayer will climb and, thus, the higher your score on reaching the end-gate. Scores are uploaded to Snake Pass' online leaderboard, should you fancy attempting to best your friends and total strangers.

Read more…

notes.title: Snake Pass adds a juicy new high-pressure arcade mode
notes.content:
Last year’s Snake Pass was a truly lovely thing. What happens when you take the platformer genre, and remove jumping, running, or even legs? Good times, that’s what. Alec reckoned it was rather brill, too.

A year on, and Sumo Digital haven’t forgotten their beautiful little experiment, even if it didn’t sell quite as much as it should have. Today, all versions of the game have been updated with a new score-chasing Arcade mode, providing a solid reason (as if it were needed) to take another peek at the game.

notes.title: UPDATE: Leaderboard Resets INCOMING
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're just wanting to provide you all with a notice about our decision to instigate a global leaderboard reset in the next week.

Not long after Snake Pass was released, tonnes of you were jumping into Time Trials across PC, Xbox One and PlayStation 4 to see who could claim the highly-coveted title of the world’s top snake charmer! Whilst we were thrilled (but secretly seething…) to see so many of you put our own scores to shame, it became quickly apparent that a small number of players had discovered several exploits in the game that gave them an unfair advantage in the great leaderboard race of 2017. 

With the release of update 1.2 several fixes have been included on all platforms that remove these exploits from the game, making leaderboard progress much more friendly. No more turbo charged Noodles for you! This also means that some of the times are no longer even vaguely beatable from this point onwards…

With that in mind, we have decided that it is in the best interests of keeping things competitive and with Nintendo Switch players joining the fray, ONE WEEK after update 1.2’s release, we will be resetting all the current leaderboards. That means that the title of ultimate snaker will be back up for grabs and the race will well and truly be on. We look forward to seeing what times you guys will be recording this time round and maybe…just maybe…we’ll stand a chance of beating them this time round! 

We truly appreciate your support and understanding!

JuhTai
- Snake Pass Team

notes.title: Update 1.2 - LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Update 1.2 hit Steam recently and we thought we'd drop you all of the details;

[list]
[*]RAZER CHROMA: support for Razer Chroma Keyboards has been added

[*]4K UI: fixed a bug where the UI was not displaying correctly on 4k monitors 

[*]LANGUAGE: Steam version now sets to the language that Steam is set to rather than the OS of the PC

[*]TAIL GRAB: fixed a bug where Tail Grab was unreliable

[*]TIME TRIAL: fixed a TT exploit where players could get a time of zero

[*]TIME TRIAL: fixed an issue in Time Trial where some players could not complete the level
[*]TIME TRIAL: fixed an issue in Time Trial that prevented the timer from not displaying correctly

[*]LEVEL 11: fixed an issue where the ball would activate incorrectly for some players

[*]QUETZALCOATL ACHIEVEMENT: fixed an issue with Quetzalcoatl not triggering correctly for some players. If players have previously reached the requirements, playing a level without dying again should trigger the achievement.

[*]FLOOR IS MOLTEN ROCK ACHIEVEMENT: The Floor Is Molten Rock achievement now triggers correctly

[*]CAMERA: fixed an issue where the camera did not move as fast as intended

[*]LEVEL 9: fixed an issue where the camera would not move for some players making the level unplayable

[*]TAIL GRAB: fixed an issue where Noodle would move faster than intended while Doodle was holding his tail

[*]GAME ICONS: all platforms have updated game icons

[*]GENERAL FIXES AND PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS
[/list]

notes.title: Sumo Digital Birthday Bash - STEAM FLASH SALE!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.sumo-digital.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/snake_pass_flash_sale-e1496336866994.jpg[/img]
Hey Everyone,

The 2nd of June is a special occasion for everyone here at Sumo Digital. Why? Because it’s our birthday and this year marks a whole 14 years since we first opened our doors as a video game development studio. That’s 14 years of working on some of the biggest and best titles, bringing entertainment to millions of people across the globe. Sssuper!

That leads us nicely on to our next point. Although we’ve been developing games for 14 years, this year also marked a massive milestone for ourselves as a company that we’re all incredibly proud of. This year we released our first original title and that title was of course Snake Pass, a game that wouldn’t have been anywhere near as successful as it has been without all of your support!

With that said, whilst we’ll no doubt be chowing down on birthday cake to celebrate the day, we wanted to share some of the festive cheer with the rest of the world too! So, that brings us to our mini announcement.

We know there are plenty of Steam players out there that have been waiting for that right moment to pick up Snake Pass, so…

[b]Starting on June 2nd at 6pm BST/ 10am PDT and ending on June 3rd at 6pm BST/ 10am PDT, Snake Pass will be on sale on STEAM for a whopping 50% off.[/b]

VISIT OUR STORE PAGE NOW! 

This is the first time that Snake Pass has been discounted on any platform! it’s the perfect opportunity to pick up the game and jump into Haven Tor this weekend.

Sound good to you guys? Awesome!

We look forward to seeing you guys slithering around and Thinking Like a Snake real soon!

James
- Snake Pass Team

notes.title: Taking a look at the first 30 days...
notes.content:
[img]http://www.sumo-digital.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/gif01v2.gif[/img]
Hey Everyone,
It’s been a little while since we’ve dropped our last update, so now that we’re just over a month since launch, what better time than now?! Thankfully things are a little less chaotic on our end, so much so that we’ve finally had chance to sit back and take everything in for the first time. It’s honestly been so much fun to actually sit back and jump onto forums/YouTube/Twitch to hear directly from you about what love (and what you dislike) about the game. So, once again a massive thank you to each and every one of you for supporting us and Snake Pass. Your feedback means so much to us and remember, we're always listening!

So, how about we take a quick look at the first 30 days of Snake Pass in stats?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26694233/44a1f9615373e242e3b794997afdb6aad0555e3e.jpg[/img]


Now sure, things have quietened down, but that’s not to say the team isn’t still hard at work, no sir-e! We’re all still committed to Snake Pass, so there’s plenty of work going on behind the scenes from upcoming patches, to quality of life changes, right through to exploring other possible avenues of getting Snake Pass into YOUR hands. Oh and there may or may not be additional content being explored too…Not that we can confirm or deny that either way. 

That being said, want to hear from YOU guys, THE PLAYERS, THE FANS. If we were to happen to be working on content ideas – what do *YOU* want to see us include in the game? Drop us a line in the comment section below, on our Steam forums or on our Social Media channels.

That about covers it this week, we’ll have a little more to talk about real soon, including what’s coming up in our next patch! 

As always, ssstay tuned!

- James

notes.title: Snake Pass and the unexplored territory of the game controller
notes.content: When we put up our review of Snake Pass [official site] I remember one of the comments asking about whether you can play the game on mouse and keyboard. It’s an interesting question. The short answer is yes, but the longer answer is about how the developers, particularly Seb Liese whose tech prototype for snake movement started the whole ball rolling (or snake slithering), saw the controller in relation to the experience of playing. The way the input feels is intended to be a part of the whole experience to the point where Liese was lobbying to ship without a mouse and keyboard option at one point because they hadn’t found one which adequately expressed the same physical elements of playing. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Wot I Think: Excellent physics-puzzler Snake Pass
notes.content:
Smarter than half a dozen BioShocks despite looking a bit like it fell from a lost GameCube promotional disc, Snake Pass [official site] is an animal physics game without the slapstick comedy that often entails. (Tail, like a snake has).

I’m not sure if it’s best referred to as a platformer or a puzzle game. The main activity in Snake Pass is progressing from one platform to another, but where historically (hiss, like a snake) platformers involve high-speed bounding from place to place, this is about slow-speed slithering, climbing and clenching. You’re a snake, see. Snakes don’t jump, apart from in that bit in David Attenborough when one of them snatches a hummingbird out of the air or something.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Ssserpentine platformer Snake Pass releasssed
notes.content: Most platformers take movement for granted. Sure, it might be tricky to nail precise timings and pull off complex chains but you have move buttons and jump buttons and they do your moving. That’s certainly not the case with Snake Pass [official site], which launched today. Sumo Digital’s platformer gives players a snake to wind, coil, and wrestle with to make him move and climb. notes.title: Lets Talk - Pricing and Dev Diaries!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26694233/2ea2911a4acbcc831f06a714c41cf0a38303d88f.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

If you’ve been keeping up with the news, you’ll know that the past few weeks have been all go for the Snake Pass team. From the Nintendo Switch news, revealing David Wise has composed the Snake Pass soundtrack, to our release date announcement last week; it’s been crazy to say the least! But, we’re still not done as we have a few things we’d like to talk about today!

https://youtu.be/YOsoM4IQhj0

[h1]THE FUN BIT - DEV DIARIES[/h1]
From game jam to digital release on four platforms simultaneously, in the past 12 months of development, Snake Pass has dramatically changed. From the scope, to level design, right through to the visual style, it’s all seen change in one way or another and has been an incredible journey to witness. When we began building Snake Pass, we thought it would be really cool to capture this evolution and pull back the curtain that often cloaks game development – bringing you some real stories direct from the dev team. It was that reason we decided to put together a series of dev diaries and we’re launching the first one today! Check it out above and let us know what you think.

“The first developer diary shows how quickly the game evolved. That original prototype already had the feel we wanted, but it was building an actual game around it that became the challenge,” Said Seb Liese, creator of Snake Pass. “Seeing that rudimentary green snake is quite comical now. We worked so hard to turn him into something charming and ended up with the Noodle you see today, a character I hope that everyone will love.”

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26694233/c367a743e9bd92cdff54c613a029d17d7032bec4.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE BIT ABOUT PRICING[/h1]
This is something we know a lot of you have been asking about and now we’re finally ready to give you guys an answer: How much will Snake Pass cost? We’re pleased to announce that Snake Pass will be available for [b]£16.99, $19.99 and €19.99[/b] on Steam! Regarding pre-orders/launch discounts these are avenues we’re exploring and will provide an update on them both at a later date, but as of right now we’re focusing our efforts on getting the game into your hands. Not long to go now!

That about covers it for now! As always, hit us up in the comments below with your thoughts and make sure you join in on the discussions over on our Steam community hub!

- James

notes.title: Happy New Year From The Snake Pass Team - Onwards To 2017!
notes.content:
[h1]It's time for the Snake Pass team to wave goodbye to 2016 and usher in 2017![/h1]

It's almost here...2017 that is! As 2016 prepares to sneak out of the back door of the theater, we've got just enough time to put this last post together for our Steam community.

For some of you, we know 2017 has already arrived (and a happy new year to you, people of the future!) but for ourselves in the United Kingdom, we're still counting down the minutes until the festivities begin and we bid adieu to 2016. 

Of course, whilst there is still life in 2016, we thought it would be cool to take a look back at this fang-tastic (There's the first Snake pun...) year as well as provide a quick sssneak peek (Two...) at what's to come from us in the future!

[h1]2016 - A Retrospect[/h1]

It goes without saying, 2016 has been one heck of a journey for us. A journey that none of us expected to be on and one that has only gone from strength to strength. 

Back in April we announced Snake Pass at EGX Rezzed in London. It seems crazy to us now looking back at it - just 4 of us manning our 2 little pods. This was a complete first for us. None of us knew what to expect or how our slithery platformer would be received. What came next totally blew our minds. 

People loved it! YOU, the fans, loved it. Hundreds of people just kept coming back for more. From the hugely positive reception of that single event, we went straight into full production. YOU helped us do that. YOU helped cement the path our game would take and we cannot thank you all enough. If you happen to be at one of our events - please, grab a hug. 

[h1] The Hype Train Doesn't Stop There [/h1]

Of course, our winding journey hasn't stopped there.

Since then? Well, that's where things have only gotten better. 
[list]
[*]We've gotten Snake Pass t-shirts and fliers. 
[*]We have a SNAKE PASS website!!! ([url=www.snake-pass.com]www.snake-pass.com if you missed it![/url])
[*]We've had fan art and gifs!
[*]We started livestreaming on Twitch- [url=www.twitch.tv/snakepass]www.twitch.tv/snakepass[/url])
[*]We showcased at EGX in Birmingham, UK.
[*]We were personally invited by the legendary DOUBLE FINE PRODUCTIONS to showcase at Day Of The Devs 2016. 
[*]We've showcased at PlayStation Experience in Anaheim, California
[*]We've had full two page articles dedicated to Snake Pass.
[*] and SO MUCH MORE. 
[/list]

Of course, there's still one thing that tops all others; [b]We made a thing[/b].
We made a thing and thousands of you loved it. So much so that here we are on Steam (and consoles stores), getting ready to ship the thing next year. THAT has been one of our biggest achievements of this year.

From gamejam to published title...Yeah, that's really cool. 

[h1]The best is yet to come[/h1]

Yet, as cliché as it may be for us to say it; [b]the best is still yet to come![/b] We still have so much more to show and share with you over the next several months. 

Although we cannot share too many details, (our marketing and PR team would kill us!) rest assured, we still have tons of important details to share about Snake Pass. 
[list]
[*]When is it coming out? 
[*]What's in the final game? 
[*]What future plans do we have? 
[*]Why can't Noodle eat Doodle?! 
[/list]

All incredibly important questions that need answers and all will be revealed in due time... You'll just have to keep a look out [b]HERE[/b], on our [url=www.snake-pass.com]WEBSITE[/url] and of course in our upcoming [b]DEV DIARIES[/b]. Wait, did we announce those yet? Oh..er... ːsteamfacepalmːːsteamhappyː

Until then, we just want to take this last opportunity to say THANK YOU for supporting both Snake Pass and Sumo Digital. It's been an incredible journey for us so far and we cannot wait for you all to jump into Snake Pass really, really soon! 

Happy New Year everyone, let's make 2017 the best yet!


- The Snake Pass Team
